summary: Config.CapabilityBindings resolves the eight neutral semantic meanings and literal ordered command declarations using independently supplied supported platforms/environments/evidence formats; any diagnostic rejects the complete request. CommandHost provider planning resolves whole declarations before selection/cache and refuses empty selections, missing required selected gates and semantic-only downgrades of executable gates. These source APIs do not establish a package-backed SDD caller or final execution profile. The owning GOV423 plan records validated provider Verify planning but retains Program on legacy parsing and valid provider plans as explicitly non-passing pending physical/package-backed loader/runtime/evidence joins. Config publication, ReferenceGateSet 1.8.0, runtime carrier publication and Templates/public receivers remain separate gates.
title: Neutral capability resolution is not a completed provider invocation
